player_action: I use Diplomacy on the hostile orc chief in the middle of combat — one round to make him friendly.
correct_ruling: Changing an attitude with Diplomacy generally takes 1 full minute. A rushed attempt as a full-round action is possible at a -10 penalty.
common_wrong_rulings: Diplomacy as a standard action with no penalty

player_action: I move silently at full speed past the sleeping guards.
correct_ruling: Moving up to half speed has no penalty; moving more than half speed and up to full speed imposes -5 on Move Silently. Running or charging is practically impossible (-20).

player_action: I take 10 on Use Magic Device to activate this wand in a quiet library.
game_state: Rogue, not threatened, using a wand of cure light wounds.
correct_ruling: Use Magic Device can't be used with take 10 (or take 20); its text specifically disallows it because magic is unpredictable.
srd_reference: SRD 3.5 SkillsII.rtf > Use Magic Device > Special

player_action: I keep trying to pick the lock until I get it.
game_state: No time pressure, no consequence for failure.
correct_ruling: Allowed: Open Lock can be retried, so with no threat or penalty for failure the rogue can take 20, taking 20 times the normal time (20 full-round actions).
srd_reference: SRD 3.5 SkillsI.rtf > Taking 20; SkillsII.rtf > Open Lock

player_action: Climbing a knotted rope against a wall is easy, so DC 5 — and I can climb at full speed.
game_state: Fighter climbing a knotted rope against a wall.
correct_ruling: A knotted rope with a wall to brace against is DC 0. Normal climbing is at one-quarter speed as a move action; accelerated climbing (half speed) is at -5.
confidence_note: DC 0 for knotted rope with wall recalled from the Climb DC table; scored point (quarter speed) is confident.
